sensitivities.name: GST s.9(5) applied to grooming (downside)
sensitivities.note: Platform pays 18% GST on grooming GMV from unregistered groomers - R3-04; CA must rule out

prelaunch.standardHow: Private Limited via an online filing service (DSC, name, stamp duty, professional fee)
prelaunch.lowcostHow: Sole proprietorship + free Udyam registration + current account; convert to Pvt Ltd/LLP only when raising equity
prelaunch.tradeoff: Proprietorship has no liability shield and no DPIIT/startup benefits; fine until ~₹20 L revenue or first investor

prelaunch.lowcostHow: Self-file on IP India with Udyam status (₹4,500 rate)
prelaunch.tradeoff: DIY risks a weak clearance search; do a free public search first

prelaunch.item: CA structuring consult (GST s.9(5), TCS, TDS 194-O, entity)
prelaunch.standardHow: Ludhiana CA, one 2-hour session + written note
prelaunch.lowcostHow: One focused call with a CA using this plan's question list
prelaunch.tradeoff: Cheapest high-impact spend in the plan - do not skip it

prelaunch.item: Lawyer review: T&Cs, privacy, provider agreement
prelaunch.standardHow: Fixed-fee review by a practising advocate
prelaunch.lowcostHow: Law-school legal-aid clinic / junior advocate fixed fee
prelaunch.tradeoff: Provider agreement (independent contractor, non-solicit) must be right before scale

prelaunch.standardHow: Domain + Google Workspace for 2 users (12 months)
prelaunch.lowcostHow: Domain + free email forwarding to Gmail

prelaunch.standardHow: New SIM + plan for 3 months; WhatsApp Business app (free)
prelaunch.lowcostHow: New prepaid SIM; WhatsApp Business app (free)
Reuse the website's design system + free Canva templates

prelaunch.item: Photo shoot (real groomers, pets, Ludhiana homes)
prelaunch.lowcostHow: Photography student on barter (free groom for their pet) + good phone
PP Saanjh verification ₹200 + Aadhaar QR check ~₹10 each
prelaunch.tradeoff: Saanjh takes up to 30 days - start now

prelaunch.standardHow: 2 embroidered polos + PVC ID with lanyard ~₹550 each
prelaunch.lowcostHow: 2 printed polos + PVC ID ~₹400 each, bought from Ludhiana hosiery suppliers

prelaunch.standardHow: Senior groomer mentor ₹1,500/session × 2 supervised sessions each
prelaunch.lowcostHow: 1 supervised session each + written SOP + video

prelaunch.standardHow: Sealed blade/towel packs + shampoo, resold to providers at cost+15%
prelaunch.lowcostHow: Smaller first order; providers buy their own to the same spec
prelaunch.tradeoff: Working capital, recovered through supplies sales

prelaunch.standardHow: 1 basic kit (clipper, dryer, scissors, tub) lent to a skilled groomer without kit, recovered via EMI from payouts
prelaunch.lowcostHow: Recruit only groomers who own a kit
The partner vet brings their own

prelaunch.tradeoff: Accident cover only, not pet-injury liability

prelaunch.item: Pilot grooms for first reviews (12 jobs at 50% off)
prelaunch.standardHow: 12 Full Grooms at half price; platform tops up the groomer

prelaunch.item: Launch print kit (flyers, standees, QR stickers)
prelaunch.standardHow: 2,000 A5 flyers + 2 roll-up standees + 500 QR stickers

perCity.standardHow: Salaried city lead ₹30k, 1 month before launch
perCity.lowcostHow: City lead on revenue share (₹10k retainer + 10% of city revenue) - no upfront cost
perCity.tradeoff: Harder to find a strong lead on revenue share

perCity.item: Operating base for GBP verification (3 months)
perCity.lowcostHow: City lead's home address (hidden service-area business)
perCity.tradeoff: GBP must still verify at a real address

perCity.lowcostHow: Bus/train day-trips; Jalandhar is 1¼ h away

perCity.standardHow: Shops & Establishments intimation / local counsel if needed
perCity.lowcostHow: Not needed for a service-area business with no premises (confirm)
